description: Refurbishment of the courtyard building to enable the provision of appropriate spaces for the reception and nursery classes; internal alterations to include, removal of selected sections of walls, selected partition walls, cladding to modern round room elements, flooring, fixed cupboards and kitchen equipment; infilling of existing wall opening to existing kitchen; installation of doorways, painted white timber doors and timber framed vision panels, stud wall clad in plasterboard partition walls, toilet facilities, classroom sinks, fixed cupboards, vinyl and carpet flooring, smartboards/whiteboards, and new equipment for a new sensory room; painting of existing walls and plasterboard suspended ceilings; refurbishment of round bench/cushion within proposed nursery reading area; provision of new seating area with kitchenette; associated internal alterations.
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
